info.description: Private REST infrastructure only: Gateway-to-Auth introspection and Gateway-to-owner operation polling. All private domain collaborations use the versioned gRPC contracts. Public REST is unchanged.

UserBearer.description: Auth-issued session token; protected new actions also check current Auth state.

WorkloadBearer.description: Per-caller opaque workload token from encrypted runtime configuration. Receiver maps it to a caller identity and enforces the operation allowlist. Never a browser token.

ActorAssertion.name: X-Actor-Context
ActorAssertion.description: RS256 gateway-signed short-lived actor admission JWT. Not a client-controlled JSON header. See identity rules in README.
